Time and Attendance. Compare each person's logged time with the required hours of every working day.
Open Time and Attendance. Choose Organization view or Individual view, and a period: today, this week, this month, last month, or custom dates.
The tiles show the number of people, the days completed, the short days, and the untracked days, with no work session.
Logged time is active time, with keyboard or mouse input, plus idle time with a customer system in front, like a call with the CRM open.

A day is Completed when logged time reaches the required hours. It is Short when the person worked, but less. A working day with no work session is Absent. Days off and holidays never count as absence.
Each row shows logged and expected hours, the status, and the completed, holiday and untracked days. Click the calendar icon, to open a person's month.
The calendar colours each day. Click a day to see the active, signed in, idle and required time, the work sessions, and any customer time.
Today shows as In progress until the day ends, and the page refreshes by itself every minute.
Click Export CSV, to download the attendance for the period.
